conditions.source:
The meeting addressed two primary items: a contract award for the 55th Way Landfill Cover Improvement Project and the adoption of an ordinance regarding billboards.

Regarding the 55th Way Landfill Cover Improvement Project, the Public Works and Financial Management departments recommended awarding a contract to road builders for a total amount not exceeding $1.1 million. This project is located in District Eight. Councilman Austin spoke in support of the measure, describing it as a significant step forward in developing Phase Two of Davenport Park. He noted that this initiative has been a priority for District Eight for several years and emphasized that grading and capping the landfill will position the community to begin developing a vibrant park in an area with high need. Following his remarks, a motion and second were recorded. No public comment was offered. The council cast their votes, with Councilmember Soprano voting in favor, and the motion carried.

The next item on the agenda was a report from Development Services. The recommendation was to declare an ordinance amending the Long Beach Municipal Code relating to billboards as read and adopted citywide. The conversation concludes with this recommendation being presented.
